sensitiveDataPolicy: synthetic data only; secrets, private paths, timestamps, and nondeterministic identifiers are forbidden
sizeBehavior: model-visible JSON is bounded by the kernel projection; raw tool output is excluded

payload.summary: plan rejected: hypothesis $HYPOTHESIS_ID_1 has no disproof path (set disproveBy; CLI --disprove or "statement :: disproof")

actions.command: cortex -C $WORKSPACE plan $TASK_ID_1 --hypothesis 'callback is wrong' --disprove DISPROOF --file src/callback.go --uncertainty unknown
actions.reason: give every hypothesis a disproof path: the observation that would show it wrong

payload.error: plan rejected: hypothesis $HYPOTHESIS_ID_1 has no disproof path (set disproveBy; CLI --disprove or "statement :: disproof")
